limitations: Catalog screening does not certify infrared constancy or exclude unresolved/faint blends.
Disjoint sources share the earlier exposure pair; independent of prior control fluxes, not independent of detector systematics.
WCS-WAVE matching is approximate; D3 CWAVE/CBAND calibration still required.

gaia.query: SELECT TOP 20000 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,pmra,pmdec,parallax,ruwe,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_variable_flag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',331.0962,-56.8005,0.18)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<=20 ORDER BY source_id

allwise.query: SELECT TOP 20000 designation,ra,dec,w1mpro,w2mpro,w1snr,w2snr,ph_qual,cc_flags,var_flg,ext_flg FROM allwise_p3as_psd WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',331.0962,-56.8005,0.18)) ORDER BY designation
